receipt.location: .preview-data/ unless PREVIEW_DATA_DIR points to another private directory
receipt.filename: SHA-256 of opaque request token; token itself is not stored in file contents
receipt.retention: Local files remain until manually cleared; no production retention policy or automatic expiration implemented. Maximum 500 receipts.

browserStorage.contactData: React component memory and one local POST only; never browser storage or URL

behavior.duplicateSubmit: Same token and same non-personal summary returns same receipt; mismatched summary returns 409.
behavior.timeout: POST aborts after 10 seconds; UI checks status with the same token before allowing an idempotent retry; status timeout 6 seconds.
behavior.confirmation: Session token plus successful server status is required. Direct URL without token shows no submitted request.
behavior.storageFailure: 503 without success; entries remain in the form.
behavior.fallback: Direct phone link 253-301-0028 and Contact & Visit route.
behavior.javascriptDisabled: No preview save; noscript contact guidance is visible.
behavior.serverLogPolicy: No request body or contact logging.

Confirm pricing, sales routing and contact/ticket/deal conventions; obtain qualified technical fitment validation. An inquiry is not a qualified opportunity.
Approve privacy/retention/commercial/consultation terms and required consent records before storing customer information.

Authorize a controlled live delivery test recipient and verify actual contact/ticket receipt, routing and deduplicated tracking. Existing native forms require both email and phone; short preview accepts either.
